title: DurableCommandRecord
description: Control-command receipt contract. Every command produces one independent record with a single authoritative writer. A transport-level success (e.g. HTTP 200) MUST NOT be interpreted as applied - applied is produced only by an executor's actual-effect receipt. expired is terminal: an expired command MUST NOT be applied afterwards. A command may carry the expected task/run revision to reject commands issued from a stale page. provide_input payloads follow the envelope pattern: a payload object plus its payload_schema_ref; the concrete payload schema is defined by consumers. Unknown fields MUST be tolerated.
